title: Orchard Valley Residences
subtitle: Unit #14-08
description:
Nestled in the heart of the Orchard Road belt, this exceptional 3-bedroom unit at Orchard Valley Residences commands breathtaking city views from the 14th floor.

The thoughtfully designed 1,334 sqft layout features an open-concept living and dining area flooded with natural light, a fully-equipped kitchen with premium Bosch appliances, and a spacious master suite with walk-in wardrobe and en-suite bathroom finished in Italian marble.

Residents enjoy access to resort-style facilities including a 50-metre infinity pool overlooking the city skyline, a state-of-the-art gymnasium, and a rooftop sky lounge — making this an ideal primary residence or investment property.
highlights: Meticulously renovated with premium German fittings
